title: 实验室安全制度：写在纸上，做在手上
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/11_Module 2 — The OSHA Laboratory Standard.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/11_Module 2 — The OSHA Laboratory Standard/src.py

points.K5: 化学卫生计划要活起来
points.K8: 特别危险物质设指定区域
points.K9: 实验室也受接触限值约束
points.K13: 泄漏后人人有权医学咨询
points.K14: 检查流程：记录就是铠甲

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一本空白安全手册，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank safety manual and waves at the camera in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 这一课讲美国的实验室安全标准。
overlay: 实验室安全制度：写在纸上，做在手上

shots.scene: 适用范围、计划、限值、培训四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a boundary circle, a blank plan binder, a gauge with a red line and a training board. No people.
shots.narration: 适用范围、卫生计划、雇主义务。

shots.scene: 检查员走进实验室，老周从柜子顶上翻出一本落灰的计划
shots.prompt_en: An inspector with a blank clipboard arrives while the older man pulls a dusty blank binder down from the top of a cabinet.
shots.narration: 检查员来了，老周翻出一本旧计划。

shots.scene: 计划里的负责人卡片上画着退休图标，化学品清单很短
shots.prompt_en: The open binder shows a blank contact card with a retirement icon and an outdated short chemical list. No people.
shots.narration: 负责人早退休了，清单也是旧的。

shots.scene: 检查员指向实验台上一排新试剂，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The inspector points at a row of new reagent bottles on the bench and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 新试剂，计划里一个字都没有。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 写在纸上，更要做在手上。

shots.scene: 一本厚厚的空白法规书，旁边美国国旗形状的图标
shots.prompt_en: A thick blank regulation book next to a simple flag icon with stars and stripes. No people.
shots.narration: 美国实验室标准，检查中引用最多。

shots.scene: 法规书翻开，浮现范围、计划、义务三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The blank regulation book opens and three icons float out: a boundary circle, a plan binder and a handshake. No people.
shots.narration: 它规定了安全实验室该有的样子。

shots.scene: 实验室门口贴着一张大罚单
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab door with a large blank penalty notice taped to it. No people.
shots.narration: 一家中型药企研发实验室，被罚款。

shots.scene: 旧计划、空椅子、过时培训三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a dusty old binder, an empty office chair for a retired manager, and an outdated training slide. No people.
shots.narration: 计划多年没改，负责人早退休。

shots.scene: 整齐的培训矩阵表格，内容却是旧日历
shots.prompt_en: A neat blank training matrix grid with an old calendar page inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 培训矩阵看着整齐，内容却过时。

shots.scene: 自燃和健康危害标识的新瓶，旁边空着没有规程
shots.prompt_en: New reagent bottles with flame-over-circle and health hazard pictograms sit beside an empty space where a procedure should be. No people.
shots.narration: 新用的自燃剂和生殖毒物，没规程。

shots.scene: 文件和现实之间裂开一道缝
shots.prompt_en: A gap opening between a document icon and a real lab icon, with a red warning mark in the gap. No people.
shots.narration: 文件与现实的落差，就是罚点。

shots.scene: 四张空白卡片：小烧瓶、多瓶试剂、划掉的工厂、护目镜手套
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards in a row: a small flask, several bottles, a crossed-out factory, and goggles with gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 适用与否，看四个条件是否同时满足。

shots.scene: 第一、二张卡片亮起
shots.prompt_en: The first two cards light up: a small flask and a cluster of different bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室规模，用多种化学品或程序。

shots.scene: 第三、四张卡片亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last two cards light up: a crossed-out factory and goggles with gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 不是生产或模拟生产，防护齐备常用。

shots.scene: 缺了一张卡片，箭头指向另一本规则书
shots.prompt_en: One card is missing and an arrow points away to a different rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 缺一项，就改用其他标准。

shots.scene: 同一栋楼里相邻的两间实验室，摆着同样的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Two adjacent lab rooms in the same building with the same reagent bottles on their benches. No people.
shots.narration: 同一栋楼，隔壁两间屋，

shots.scene: 左边屋里多种烧瓶在做方法开发，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The left room shows method development with many different flasks and solvents, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 方法开发：多溶剂小规模，适用本标准。

shots.scene: 右边屋里一排相同样品重复检测，箭头指向危害告知规则本
shots.prompt_en: The right room shows the same release test repeated on a row of production samples; an arrow points to a hazard communication rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 质检放行只测生产批次，算模拟生产。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着右边的屋子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the right room.
shots.narration: 所以改适用危害告知标准。

shots.section_title: 化学卫生计划要活起来
shots.scene: 计划像电脑操作系统一样连着各个设备图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan binder at the center connected like an operating system to icons of a fume hood, bottles, people and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 化学卫生计划，是实验室的操作系统。
overlay: 化学卫生计划要活起来

shots.section_title: 化学卫生计划要活起来
shots.scene: 计划里列着拆掉的通风橱和没人用的化学品，被红圈
shots.prompt_en: Pages of a blank binder listing an icon of a removed fume hood and bottles nobody uses, circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 列着拆掉的通风橱，漏了新库存。

shots.section_title: 化学卫生计划要活起来
shots.scene: 五年前的落灰文件夹，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A dusty binder with an old calendar showing five years ago, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 法规要求制定并执行，落灰不算数。

shots.section_title: 化学卫生计划要活起来
shots.scene: 老周修改计划，阿杰和小研在旁边签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man updates the blank binder while the female graduate student and the young male student sign beside him.
shots.narration: 它是实验室和人之间的工作协议。

shots.scene: 空白计划翻开，目录上有八个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank binder opened to a contents page with eight small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 标准不给模板，但要求八个要素：

shots.scene: 规程本、判定天平、通风橱三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a procedure book, a balance for control criteria and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 操作规程、控制判定标准、防护设备。

shots.scene: 培训黑板、审批章、医院十字三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a training board, an approval stamp and a medical cross with a free tag. No people.
shots.narration: 培训信息、事先批准、免费医学咨询。

shots.scene: 负责人胸牌和上锁专柜两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a blank officer badge and a locked special cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 指定负责人，特别危险物质加保护。

shots.scene: 通风橱在转，旁边没有标签，问号
shots.prompt_en: A running fume hood with no certification tag and a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 通风橱听着正常，没年度认证标签，

shots.scene: 老李测面风速，贴上空白认证标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures face velocity with an airflow meter and sticks a blank certification tag on the hood.
shots.narration: 就是检查头条：要有书面测量记录。

shots.section_title: 特别危险物质设指定区域
shots.scene: 致癌、生殖毒性、高急毒三个标识的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: Bottles with health hazard, reproductive toxicity and skull and crossbones pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 致癌物、生殖毒物、高急性毒性物质，
overlay: 特别危险物质设指定区域

shots.section_title: 特别危险物质设指定区域
shots.scene: 一块用隔断围起来的指定区域，门口有警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A designated area enclosed by a partition with a warning sign and an access gate. No people.
shots.narration: 要设指定区域：隔离、标识、管出入。

shots.section_title: 特别危险物质设指定区域
shots.scene: 一小瓶和一大桶都放进指定区域，等号连起来
shots.prompt_en: A tiny vial and a large drum both going into the designated area, joined by an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 五毫克还是五加仑，要求都一样。

shots.section_title: 特别危险物质设指定区域
shots.scene: 指定区域旁的专用废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A dedicated labeled waste container beside the designated area. No people.
shots.narration: 废物也有专门的处理规定。

shots.section_title: 实验室也受接触限值约束
shots.scene: 实验室空气中飘着分子，旁边一条限值红线
shots.prompt_en: Molecule icons floating in a lab air space next to a gauge with a red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 容许接触限值，跟着化学品进实验室。
overlay: 实验室也受接触限值约束

shots.section_title: 实验室也受接触限值约束
shots.scene: 实验室图标上一个被划掉的豁免章
shots.prompt_en: A lab room icon with a crossed-out exemption stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室不豁免，限值是法定上限。

shots.section_title: 实验室也受接触限值约束
shots.scene: 限值红线下面一条黄色线，标着一半
shots.prompt_en: Below the red limit line there is a yellow line marked at half height on the gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 通常一半处是行动水平，

shots.section_title: 实验室也受接触限值约束
shots.scene: 监测仪、培训板、听诊器三个图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up: an air monitor, a training board and a stethoscope. No people.
shots.narration: 达到就要监测、培训和医学监护。

shots.scene: 二氯甲烷瓶旁一个刻度表，红线和黄线
shots.prompt_en: A blank solvent bottle next to a gauge with a red line and a yellow line. No people.
shots.narration: 二氯甲烷限值百万分之25。

shots.scene: 小研在通风橱里用升量溶剂萃取，旁边空气采样器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student does a liter-scale extraction inside a fume hood while a small air sampling device sits nearby.
shots.narration: 常用升量萃取，可能超12.5，

shots.scene: 老李拿着空气检测仪在实验室采样
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes an air sample in the lab with a handheld detector.
shots.narration: 法律要求做初始空气监测。

shots.scene: 日历上标出复测日期
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a follow-up date circled. No people.
shots.narration: 高于行动水平，就要定期复测。

shots.scene: 日历上圈出15个工作日
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a block of fifteen working days circled. No people.
shots.narration: 监测结果，15个工作日内书面告知。

shots.scene: 报告锁在档案柜里落灰，旁边日历翻过14页
shots.prompt_en: A test report locked in a dusty file cabinet while fourteen calendar pages flip by, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有实验室14个月没告知，被罚款。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地摇手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wags a finger seriously.
shots.narration: 认定故意违规，没有例外。

shots.scene: 只有签名的签到表，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A sign-in sheet with only signatures, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 签到表对检查毫无用处。

shots.scene: 阿杰培训后在电脑上答题，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a quiz on a computer with a blank screen after a training session.
shots.narration: 出勤不等于培训，要证明能力。

shots.scene: 培训记录卡上几行图标：姓名、日期、讲师、版本、时长
shots.prompt_en: A blank training record card with rows of icons: a person, a calendar, a teacher, a version number tag and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 姓名、日期、讲师资质、规程版本。

shots.scene: 记录卡下方的分数和签名栏
shots.prompt_en: The bottom of the record card with a quiz score box and a signature line. No people.
shots.narration: 还有时长、测验成绩和签字确认。

shots.section_title: 泄漏后人人有权医学咨询
shots.scene: 合成时地上一小摊苯酚泄漏，三个人在屋里
shots.prompt_en: A small chemical spill on a lab floor during a synthesis, with the female graduate student, the young male student and the older man in the room.
shots.narration: 合成中苯酚泄漏，同屋三个人。
overlay: 泄漏后人人有权医学咨询

shots.section_title: 泄漏后人人有权医学咨询
shots.scene: 只有阿杰扶着额头说头疼
shots.prompt_en: Only the young male student holds his forehead with a headache; the other two look fine.
shots.narration: 只有一人头痛，另两人没感觉。

shots.section_title: 泄漏后人人有权医学咨询
shots.scene: 三个人都走向医务室
shots.prompt_en: All three walk together toward a clinic building with a red cross.
shots.narration: 三人都有权获得医学咨询。

shots.section_title: 泄漏后人人有权医学咨询
shots.scene: 钱袋图标指向雇主，空白记录本上登记谢绝
shots.prompt_en: A money bag icon pointing to an employer building, and a blank logbook entry with a declined mark. No people.
shots.narration: 费用雇主出，谢绝也要记录已提供。

shots.section_title: 检查流程：记录就是铠甲
shots.scene: 流程图：首次会议、现场巡查、访谈
shots.prompt_en: A flowchart with three icons: a meeting table, a camera and tape measure for a walkthrough, and two chairs for a private interview. No people.
shots.narration: 首次会议、现场巡查拍照、员工访谈，
overlay: 检查流程：记录就是铠甲

shots.section_title: 检查流程：记录就是铠甲
shots.scene: 桌上摊开计划、培训矩阵、暴露记录
shots.prompt_en: A table with a blank plan binder, a training matrix and an exposure record binder laid out. No people.
shots.narration: 再审记录，这是主要防线。

shots.section_title: 检查流程：记录就是铠甲
shots.scene: 总结会议，日历翻过几周后一张通知
shots.prompt_en: A closing meeting icon, then calendar pages flip by for weeks before a blank citation notice arrives. No people.
shots.narration: 总结会议，几周后才发处罚通知。

shots.section_title: 检查流程：记录就是铠甲
shots.scene: 三天、十二间实验室、十人、十周四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a three-day calendar, twelve small lab doors, ten person pictograms and a ten-week calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 某大学查3天、12间屋，10周后通知。

shots.scene: 档案室一排排档案盒
shots.prompt_en: Rows of blank archive boxes on shelves in a records room. No people.
shots.narration: 暴露和医学记录，离职后存30年。

shots.scene: 旧电脑的数据迁移到新电脑
shots.prompt_en: Data arrows moving from an old computer to a new computer. No people.
shots.narration: 比设备、人甚至楼都长，换系统要迁移。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着计划和实验室图片对比
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank binder next to a picture of the current lab, comparing them.
shots.narration: 检查员今天上门，计划和现实相符吗？

shots.scene: 计划里新增一页，新试剂瓶图标加入
shots.prompt_en: A new page is added to the binder with icons of the new reagent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 新化学品写进去了吗？培训经得起查吗？

shots.scene: 落灰的书被红叉，旁边一本带日历的计划打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dusty static book crossed out with a red X beside a binder with a calendar and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 静态的安全计划，注定失败。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四张要件卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating blank cards.
shots.narration: 四要件定适用，计划要跟实验室变。

shots.scene: 八要素目录和认证标签图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eight-item contents page and a certification tag. No people.
shots.narration: 八个要素齐全，通风橱年年认证。

shots.scene: 指定区域和限值刻度表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a designated area and a gauge with red and yellow lines. No people.
shots.narration: 特别危险物质设区，限值监测要告知。

shots.scene: 培训记录卡、医务室、档案盒三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a training record card, a clinic cross and an archive box. No people.
shots.narration: 培训证能力，咨询人人有，存30年。

shots.scene: 欣欣合上计划挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes the blank binder and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 计划做在手上，下次见！
